## Edit

Song, cut, frame range and intended effect.

## Review

Before/after clip or frame samples. Include an audio-on clip when timing, camera motion or singing changed.

## Verification

Commands run, renderer version if relevant, and anything that still needs playback or creative review.

## Continuation

Update the production's STATUS and session log; link any new decisions and the next concrete action. For structure changes, run `python3 tools/studio.py --check`. Record whether this is a proposal, implemented candidate, or an accepted revision; automated checks alone do not establish creative approval.
